style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern community aid table after a household flood. A smiling adult donor freely empties a generous handful of plain unmarked coins from an open purse into a transparent donation jar held on a steady table. The donor looks warmly toward a relieved parent and child whose small stack of water-stained belongings and damp boots show their need. A volunteer beside the jar prepares blankets and groceries for the family. Clear voluntary generosity with money, no buying or exchange, no payment for goods, no recipient portrayed as greedy. All coins without symbols, no text on jar, no signs, letters, brands or numbers. Natural hands with five fingers, realistic purse grip, coins falling downward into jar, stable table and anatomically sound people. Landscape 3:2, pencil outlines, soft watercolor and colored pencil, ivory paper.
alt: 一名居民微笑打開錢包，將一大把硬幣捐進透明罐，志工準備毯子與食物，受水災的親子在旁感激地看著。
